description:
Where the Internet Lives is a Webby Award–winning podcast and mini-documentary series about the fascinating world of data centers. 

This film features Dexory, a trailblazing London-based robotics and AI company, and its dynamic co-founder, Google alumna Oana Jinga. Dexory is leading the transformation of warehouse logistics with its 46-foot autonomous robot, the tallest in the world, which uses advanced sensors to scan over 100,000 pallets daily.

Want more? Check out seasons 3 and 4 of our series here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL590L5WQmH8dLLdbnJ775gPNvMeVWHLxT

Learn more about Google Data Centers here: https://datacenters.google/

description:
We sat down with filmmaker Niklas Klabunde as he shares his tips for keeping shots cohesive. Thanks Niklas Klabunde for the partnership! 

How do you ensure your shots look like they belong to the same film? 
"Do not change your prompt structure in the middle of the video… Work on a prompt structure where you get a result that you want and use that same structure for each shot." Use the Prompt Expander to help you lock in that specific prompt structure and maintain a seamless visual style across your entire film. 

Over the coming weeks, we're sharing unique workflows and tips from more creators pushing their boundaries. Make sure to follow so you don't miss the next episode!
